items.title: Generators with p-power and p-multiple conditions plus locally nilpotent kernel give a universal homeomorphism
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file algebra.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that a ring map generated by elements satisfying the p-power and p-multiple conditions, with locally nilpotent kernel, induces a homeomorphism on spectra with controlled residue field extensions, and that these hypotheses are stable under base change (statement lines 11084-11097). The proof isolates the set of elements satisfying the two conditions, shows it is closed under the ring operations and contains the images of the base by discarding kernel elements through local nilpotence, and then reads the conclusions off that the set is everything (proof lines 11099-11127). Proving closure of that set under the operations is the step that carries the argument. H2.
